boxes.en: In the past, the Bodhisatta was reborn as Prince Brahmadatta in Benares. Educated in the Three Vedas and Eighteen Sciences at Taxila, his father appointed him viceroy.

“Led astray by superstition, men wantonly sacrifice life,” thought the Bodhisatta. “When succeed to my inheritance, will devise clever stratagem to stop this evil without harming 2 single human being.”
The prince began visiting holy banyan tree. He offered perfumes and flowers, sprinkled water, and paced reverently around its trunk, behaving like true believer in the Devata.
When his father died, the Bodhisatta ruled in his stead. Shunning the four evil courses and practicing the ten royal virtues, the time arrived to fulfill his former resolve.
“Do you know how made myself king? Have you seen me reverently worshipping the banyan tree?”
made vow,” the King declared. “If became king by the help of the Devata, would offer sacrifice to that tree. Prepare it with all speed.”
“My vow was this: will slay all who are addicted to the Five Defilements and the Ten Paths of Unrighteousness. With their flesh and blood, Iwill will make my offering.”
“Twill will slay one thousand such transgressors,” he commanded. “Proclaim by beat of drum that the king will sacrifice all subjects who break the Precepts in the god’s honor.”

Obedient ministers proclaimed the decree by beat of drum throughout Benares. The threat of thousand brutal sacrifices struck immediate terror into the hearts of the townsfolk.
